name: hovercard4

frames.best_why: The headline is underlined in its hover state and the whole card reads clearly, photo and button included.

tagline: Blog card with a plant photo, date line and bright green Read Story button.
summary: A dark blog post card pairing a close-up plant photo with a publish date, a two-line headline that underlines on hover, and a green Read Story button whose arrow doubles.
appearance: A dark card topped by a close-up photo of a tall green plant in a wild meadow. Below, a small grey date line sits above a two-line white headline and a rounded green 'Read Story' button with a chevron.
behaviour: On hover the photo brightens and eases from a slight zoom to full size, the headline gains an underline, and the button arrow slides down into a double chevron as the button widens slightly.
demo_content: Date '9 Dec 2023'; headline 'Why good UX matters, and how to get it right on your site'.
search_phrases: article teaser with read story button
news card that zooms photo on hover
use_when: A blog index or news feed needs compact post teasers with a clear read link.
avoid_when: The demo hardcodes one post and its Unsplash photo, so a real feed needs the data wired in.
customise: The photo URL, date, headline and link text are hardcoded; the green button colour and sizing need a source edit. No props.
weight_why: One image and CSS transitions on scale, brightness, underline and icon.

a11y.note: The photo's alt text says 'shoes' though it shows a plant, and hover-only cues ignore prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: Alt text 'shoes' does not match the plant photo.
The headline underline and arrow change are hover-only, with no focus equivalent.
polish_why: Clean typographic card; generic layout and mismatched alt text keep it ordinary.
title: Blog Post Card
